subject: The {surname} family home: the year ahead
body:
Hi {givenName},

This is the Habitat OC team checking in on the {surname} family home. We looked ahead at your house payment. {shock} Nothing is wrong, and there is time to get ready.

One step that helps most right now: {step}. Reply to this message or give us a call, and we'll do it with you.

Habitat for Humanity of Orange County
